registry_info.description: The prefab belt (Palle, 2026-11-21): one machine for the whole prefab timeline - a band with four trays between two housings, stepped with two keys or rolled with a lever.

prefab_belt.name: Prefab belt / four of the timeline at a time
prefab_belt.description: A conveyor band like an airport security band: two housings at its ends and four trays between them. The prefab timeline (commons/data/inventory/items.json, in the order of the floor that gives each item) runs through it; two keys step it one tray, a lever rolls it. A thing given on the floor the machine stands on shows itself and can be taken; an earlier thing also shows its association line - fire_extinguisher = association(config(cylinder)); a later thing is a closed box with the floor that opens it. config: include prefabs|all, floor, mini, title, start, formula_here.
